notes.summary: The page continues a statement about the n.th-power homomorphism on the Picard prescheme. It discusses a method using non-flat descent and explicitly mentions the absence of a good effectivity criterion. It then states a theorem about a Picard-functor homomorphism under assumptions a) and b), gives an inline exactness expression, discusses a factorisation f = vu, and adds a Corollary 1. The marginal question is placed beside the underlined replacement-of-S clause. The last sentence continues beyond this sheet. This is a description of the page, without proof verification.
author_checks: I do not have any good effectivity criterion
notes.editorial_notes: H has a textual transcription. Its two French notes were read as editorial background only; they are not inserted as page text. No other-page image, other-reader file, OCR output or external research was consulted.
notes.mathematics: No independent theorem, exactness assertion or representability claim was checked. No mathematical fact was used to replace a visible glyph. The prime, indices, raised marks and arrows were decided or left open from their strokes.
notes.image_delivery: Each source image and crop was emitted in its own tool result; no image delivery was discarded.
notes.source_layers: Recoverable cancelled material is retained. The source has no free-standing diagram; the curved bracket and descending stroke at finite direct sums of are insertion attachment marks, encoded by the insertion convention and inventoried.
